# IKEA

> IKEA is a global furniture and home furnishing retailer offering affordable, well-designed products through regional storefronts, online shopping, and international sales channels.

IKEA operates a worldwide network of regional storefronts across multiple languages and markets, supported by corporate governance through Inter IKEA Group. The brand emphasizes sustainability, customer support, and accessibility while maintaining a strong digital presence for e-commerce and customer engagement.

## Global & Regional Storefronts

- [IKEA Global Homepage](https://www.ikea.com): IKEA global homepage with furniture, design inspiration, and product collections
- [IKEA Canada (English)](https://www.ikea.com/ca/en): IKEA Canada storefront with furniture, home décor, and loyalty program offerings
- [IKEA Canada (French)](https://www.ikea.com/ca/fr): IKEA Canada French-language storefront for furniture and home furnishing shopping
- [IKEA UAE (English)](https://www.ikea.com/ae/en): IKEA UAE regional storefront with furniture, promotions, and fast delivery options
- [IKEA UAE (Arabic)](https://www.ikea.com/ae/ar): IKEA UAE regional storefront in Arabic with furniture and home décor shopping
- [IKEA Poland](https://www.ikea.com/pl/pl): IKEA Poland storefront with furniture, home furnishings, and loyalty programs
- [IKEA Morocco (English)](https://www.ikea.com/ma/en): IKEA Morocco storefront with Ramadan cashback promotion and online shopping
- [IKEA Morocco (French)](https://www.ikea.com/ma/fr): IKEA Morocco storefront in French with affordable furniture and home inspiration
- [IKEA Morocco (Arabic)](https://www.ikea.com/ma/ar): IKEA Morocco storefront in Arabic with furniture shopping and Ramadan promotions

## Corporate & International Sales

- [Inter IKEA Group](https://www.inter.ikea.com): Corporate overview of Inter IKEA Group structure, governance, and operations
- [International Sales](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/international-sales): International shipping and bulk ordering for countries without IKEA stores
- [Careers at IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/jobs): IKEA careers page with global job opportunities and company culture information

## Editorial & News

- [Stories](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/stories): Editorial content hub featuring design stories, product inspiration, and lifestyle articles
- [Newsroom](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/newsroom): Press releases and corporate news about IKEA brand, sustainability, and collaborations

## Customer Support & Information

- [Get in Touch with IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/contact-ikea-submit-complaint): Contact page for complaints, product safety concerns, and supply chain issues
- [More Information](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/more-information): FAQ and business information about IKEA including franchisee and supplier inquiries

## Optional Resources

- [Privacy & Cookie Statement](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/privacy/privacy-cookie-statement): Privacy policy and cookie statement covering data protection and user rights
- [Digital Accessibility Statement](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/accessibility): Accessibility statement detailing WCAG 2.1 compliance and inclusive design practices
- [Sitemap](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/sitemap): Sitemap providing navigation across IKEA global sites and worldwide stores
